acp-task-monitor-lifecycle.note: one ACP monitor start, 120 transient heartbeats, completion, and final usage attribution

agent-created-codex-thread-token-miser-o.note: one agent-command Codex thread creation with an explicit Token Miser override; the override adds one commit to ordinary creation

automation-run-transcript-burst.note: 2,500 completed tool items across 50 windows, one shutdown-boundary artifact write

automation-run-usage.note: 50 cumulative pricing snapshots for one run, one debounced payload write

cleanup-expired-gc-pass.note: one whole cleanupExpired GC pass doing real work in both composer sweeps: ageing out 20 drafts past 180 days AND collapsing a 30-row journal prefix chain to 1. commits is the assertion that matters (every sweep rides one transaction); statements/rows legitimately move when a sweep is added, so re-record rather than reading it as a composer regression

completed-questionnaire-transcript.note: persist one completed questionnaire transcript summary

composer-draft-typing.note: 70 direct store saves (a stress case for prefix collapse, NOT the app's typing cadence — the renderer coalesces to one save per 5s): exactly one journal row survives, and commits track save calls because each save is its own transaction

config-store-config-revision.note: one atomic durable config publication per changed config revision; ordinary domain reads write nothing

config-store-provider-refresh.note: one provider-scoped last-known-good publication per successful discovery; refresh metadata remains in memory

deferred-check-alert.note: five in-memory 30-second deferred checks and one persisted alert boundary

federated-child-archive-ungroup.note: clear one child-owner parent overlay and refresh its root-owner pin

federated-child-materialization-with-par.note: materialize one cross-instance child, mount its companion parent, persist the route, and add a viewer rank because Directory Threads is collapsed while Pins is active

federated-child-mount.note: persist one cross-instance child mount and its routing target

federated-navigation-search-projection.note: one owner-side bounded navigation search projection

idle-hour-runtime-leases.note: one idle hour: PID-owned messaging and federation leases

live-thread-token-usage.note: 500 cumulative usage observations across 10 turns, then one terminal flush

live-thread-token-usage-timer-windows.note: 10 cumulative live-usage observations separated by full one-second timer windows

messaging-agent-conversation-rename.note: one agent-driven conversation rename persists the binding title and re-renders the status card inline (no bus event exists for binding-local mutations); bounded by explicit tool calls, not per turn or per item

messaging-binding-revoke.note: one bus-driven binding revoke including Agent Session close status

messaging-outbound-file-activity.note: one send_messaging_file audit row; this runs per agent tool call, so the row count must not grow with attachment parts

native-subagent-discovery-backfill.note: one missing native child pricing row and parent sub-agent card discovered from the thread list

native-subagent-pricing-repair.note: one missing native child pricing row repaired from its existing parent sub-agent card

provider-thread-snapshot-refresh.note: one secret-free provider thread projection per successful full provider list, never per thread

runtime-lease-dead-owner-takeover.note: observe one dead owner, wait one minute, replace both runtime leases

runtime-lease-lifecycle.note: register once, acquire and release both runtime leases, mark exited

star-map-intake-launchpad-initialization.note: initialize one missing directory launchpad for its first Star Map intake

star-map-workspace-gesture.note: one coalesced Star Map open/close/move/resize/toggle or camera gesture, feature-pinned to one API call and persisted as one atomic workspace row

streamed-command-output.note: 500 streamed output deltas plus the completion for one command

streamed-large-output-alert-boundary.note: five large streamed outputs and their first repeated-output alert

structured-mcp-output-alert.note: one capped structured MCP result and its alert in one boundary

thread-compaction-markers.note: two compaction markers plus one cold-replay usage line whose attribution rides the pricing-ledger transaction

thread-pricing-lazy-repair.note: one thread load lazily reprices 25 usage rows in ten-row progress batches; a second load is read-only

thread-spend-alert-boundary.note: one pending total-spend alert and one renderer acknowledgement; repeated updates and acknowledgements are read-only

token-miser-retrieval-ledger.note: one previously gated output retrieved in a later parent turn, updating its savings equation at the turn boundary

token-miser-turn-ledger.note: nine finalized Token Miser helper lines persisted during the active turn, plus one batched parent overlay write at completion

tool-output-history-analysis.note: replace 25 deterministic history findings plus coverage metadata in one explicit analysis transaction
